name: AL Language XApp D
brief: Cross-app fixture D: a subscriber app that depends on cross-app fixture A only (and System Application); it declares an app logo.
description: Holds one subscriber of an event of cross-app fixture A. Depends on cross-app fixture A only; only cross-app fixture C depends on it (writer UI, dependency visit order). It depends on none of cross-app fixtures B and C or the main test app (subscriber order of apps that do not depend on each other). The app id, name and publisher are fixed on purpose: they decide the candidate orders of the probe (tests/al-language-xapp-a/QyXaObjects.al). Do not change them.
